name: Pi
description: Build coding agents on a minimal harness — a unified LLM API across providers, a compact agent loop, a terminal UI, and MCP support, from Armin Ronacher and Mario Zechner.

skills.name: Unified LLM API
skills.description: Presents one interface across model providers so an agent loop swaps models without changing its calling code.

skills.name: Agent Loop
skills.description: Supplies a compact, low-overhead reasoning and tool-calling loop intended to be read and modified rather than configured.

skills.name: Terminal Interface
skills.description: Ships a TUI and coding-agent CLI for running the harness interactively against a local codebase.
